dialogues.speaker: Purum
dialogues.text: I'm aware that the question I'm about to ask you will drag this out even longer.

dialogues.speaker: Purum
dialogues.text: Do you have any idea how long it's been since we sat down to eat? Any at all?

dialogues.speaker: Kwame
dialogues.text: Hmm, I haven't really been paying attention. About the amount of time it takes to eat a Tataco?

dialogues.speaker: Purum
dialogues.text: The amount of time it takes you to eat a Tataco, more like! I've just about digested my whole darn meal here!

dialogues.speaker: Kwame
dialogues.text: Wow, impressive. But what's the rush? Besides, after you've just finished eating, it's always a good idea to take a rest before you set off — helps keep the stomachache at bay.

dialogues.speaker: Purum
dialogues.text: You're not seriously suggesting I should be thanking you, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Kwame
dialogues.text: Actually, yes, I suppose I am.
